notes: Three-ton 14 SEER R-410A heat pump outdoor unit, 208/230 V single phase; the parts cover the GSZ140361KA, KB and KC suffixes, and the fan motor part number differs between KA and KB/KC. Ratings are from the 0361K* column of Goodman's SS-GSZ14 spec sheet (8/20): scroll compressor RLA 15.4 A and LRA 83.9 A, condenser fan motor 1/6 hp and 0.95 A full load.

gaps: The parts list (RP-G4002J, July 2016) covers GSZ140361KA, KB and KC; the spec sheet (SS-GSZ14, 8/20) has 0361K* and 0361L* columns. Only 0361K* is used, read as the KA to KC suffixes because the sheet's nomenclature makes the tenth character the major revision.
The 0361L* column of the spec sheet is not claimed.
Compressor RLA/LRA and fan motor amps come from the spec sheet and are in the notes, because each part claim cites one source and the parts list does not give them.
The spec sheet's continued table (p.4) gives the charge as 115 with no unit on that page; ounces is taken from the row label on the first page of the same table.
The venturi ring is listed as size 22 with no unit.
Solenoid coil B1225022 is listed in the tubing group with no model code and no stated use, so it is not claimed.
A second defrost control, 0130M00250, is listed without a model code beside PCBDM133; which one is fitted is not shown.
The compressor make is not named in the sources.
method: Goodman SS-GSZ14 Product Specifications, form 8/20, read from Goodman's brochure server (apps.goodmanmfg.com): PDF p.1 (cabinet and coil features), p.2 (nomenclature), p.4 (0361K* column: compressor type and amps, fan motor, line sizes, charge, electrical data).
Goodman RP-G4002J GSZ14 Remote Heat Pump Repair Parts, July 2016, read from a SupplyHouse copy that carries Goodman's copyright line and form number; no copy on Goodman's own site was found.

RP-G4002J PDF p.1 (model list), p.3 (functional parts list with the M-code model table, M15 to M17 = GSZ140361KA, KB, KC), p.5 (control box), p.7 (compressor and tubing), p.9 (cabinet, fan and venturi).
Retail parts pages seen in search results were not opened.

comps.spec: Compressor, Goodman part ZP31K6EPFV130, listed as 208/230/60/1, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Condenser motor, 1/6 hp: Goodman part 0131M00060 on GSZ140361KA, and 0131M00753 (description ends AL) on KB and KC
Fan blade listed as type 2, Goodman part B1086764, with molded venturi ring part 0161R00048 (size listed as 22); both used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Capacitor 5/45/440V, listed as DUAL RD, Goodman part CAP050450440CT, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Contactor, 25 amp, 1P, 24V as listed, Goodman part CONT1P025024V, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Maximum overcurrent protection 35 A (time-delay fuse or HACR breaker) and minimum circuit ampacity 20.2 A for the 0361K* unit.
Reversing valve, Goodman part 0151R00069, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Cut-out switches, high pressure Goodman part 0130M00089 and low pressure 0130M00088; listed without a model code, which the list's legend says means all models

Copper tube and enhanced aluminum fin coil. 0361K* column: refrigerant line size 3/8 in liquid and 7/8 in suction, valve connections 3/8 in liquid and 3/4 in suction, refrigerant charge 115 oz (R-410A, set for 15 ft of 3/8 in liquid line).
Heavy-gauge galvanized steel cabinet with a sound control top and a steel louver coil guard.
Defrost control board, Goodman part PCBDM133, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Crankcase heater, 230V 40W, Goodman part 0163R00006, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
Accumulator, size .875, Goodman part 0151L00008, used on GSZ140361KA, KB and KC
